description: Agent memory's write path, end to end: a fix round closes a verified gap, record_lessons turns it into a lesson through memory record, and phase 2's executors receive it. Reports whether phase 2's code shows the lesson (the effect); memory-lesson-control is the same run without the memory.
why: Memory optimisation O6: agent memory had a read path and almost no writes (F4). This proves the gated write path works in the shipped flow, and measures whether a lesson changes the next phase's behaviour. Run --repeat 2 beside memory-lesson-control: if two reps show no effect over the control, the layer is retired and the reason recorded (docs/specs/memory-optimization-2026-10.md).

steps.why: The ledger holds the open gap, as exec-phase would have recorded it when the verification ran.
The fix round: the gap-closure plan runs, the verifier re-checks, the gap is auto-fixed in the ledger, and record_lessons runs.
A lesson with `evidence: finding:` is in memory: the gated write path ran in the shipped flow.
The next phase. Its session persists so the check can read what each executor was given.
The lesson reached phase 2's executors. `effect.validates` is the measurement compared with the control; it is reported, not asserted.
Working code: the seed's tests pass after both phases.
